info.title: TypeRead Core Service & IPC API Contract
info.description: Formal contract defining commands, queries, payload schemas, exact status codes, and error models for TypeRead offline desktop application. Adheres to strict anti-slop rules: zero vague types, explicit enums, invariant assertions.
